# Security policy

Report a security problem in FullAura privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/vbabenko97/fullaura/security/advisories/new). Please do not open a public issue for it, because the hosted closed beta handles people's photographs and invites.

Reports are welcome for the code on `main` and for the [hosted closed beta](https://fullaura-demo.blackbay-aaeee2c5.francecentral.azurecontainerapps.io), which closes on 10 November 2026. Please include the steps that show the problem and what someone could gain from it.

When you test the hosted beta, please do not use another person's invite or photographs, try to read other people's records, or send automated traffic, because each model call is paid.

One person maintains FullAura, so there is no guaranteed response time.
